(a) REPO-WIDE RULES. Every in-force standing rule of every OTHER record renders in renderStatus (SessionStart, sofar_get_state, the lane) inside the PROTECTED constraints block, after this record's own rules: header `Repo-wide rules from other records (<shown> of <N>, most relevant first):`, entries `- [<slug> D<n>] <rule>` with the operator quote exactly as memory-lead D2 renders it. Own rules render as today and take the 2,000 budget first; foreign rules take what own rules leave, capped at 1,200 chars, ranked by D4 relevance to the same focus (ties newest first), whole entries only, then `- …and K more in other records (their decisions.md)`. Retirement mirrors the fold (a rule falls only to a ruled superseder of its own record); closing a record retires nothing; SOFAR_RETIRE=off shows superseded ones as it does for own rules. Source: the decision-scope tier (guards.json) now keeps EVERY ruled decision; INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSION bumps; SessionStart refreshes the tier once for neighbours and rules.
(b) CROSS-RECORD REVERSAL. The D31 check (r1-fixes) also compares a draft with the standing decisions of every other record. Source: a new derived tier .sofar/.index/labels.json on its own cursor, read only by the writers: per record, decisions whose chose and over are each ≤600 chars (a lexicon-free proxy; sides() still decides label size at query time), minus superseded ones (the fold's rule) and until-scoped ones (task resolution is not indexed, so they never ground a cross-record refusal). (c) CRITERION, one rule for both scopes: N reverses P when its distinguishing terms land ≥1/3 both ways (today), OR ≥1/4 both ways AND N and P share a SUBJECT term (a stem in both chose and over of N and in both chose and over of P).

over: An explicit `scope: "repo"` field on decision_logged (schema and rust-core fingerprint change, r1-fixes D22, and it asks the capturing agent for exactly the judgement round 1's agent failed); one merged relevance ranking of own and foreign rules (incidental overlap would displace a record's own law; r1-fixes' 13 rules already fill the budget); a qualified `supersedes: "<slug> D<n>"` (the target's own fold never sees it, so its digest keeps the retired rule; making it visible means every reader unions every log, changing fold parity and rust-core); folding every record at append time (O(repo history) per decision in a cold CLI); lowering only the threshold (1/4 adds 4 false cross-record refusals on the scan, 1/5 adds 8); warn-only cross-record (D31 (a)); comparing only rules (the round-1 cross-record target was unruled); rendering foreign rules only when they share a focus term (the operator's whole-app rule may share no word with the next task, which is the case this exists for).
